description: This PHP class represents an admin controller for managing the 'Total' extension in OpenCart. It contains methods for rendering the configuration page and saving its settings, handling permissions, loading dependencies, and generating URLs and view data.

classes.name: Total
classes.description: Controller class for handling the Total extension configuration in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the configuration page for the Total extension, setting up breadcrumbs, loading language resources, configuration parameters, and common controllers for the layout.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration settings for the Total extension, including permission check, saving the request data, and returning success or error status as JSON.
